acceptanceCriteria: A checked-in shard list or target covers every test in both packages exactly once, each shard <600s on the reference host.
A check fails when a new test is not covered by any shard.
body: Observed by the batch-1019c lane (PR #1209, 2026-10-19): full-package runs of internal/tasks/store took ~1525s and internal/tasks/cli ~616s under host load, beyond the 10-minute foreground tool limit, so lanes ran 5 and 2 manual -run shards. Expected: a documented shard set (or make target / corvint test selection) that splits these packages into <600s pieces covering every test, or faster tests.
title: internal/tasks/store (~1525s) and internal/tasks/cli (~616s) exceed the 600s foreground tool limit; lanes shard them by hand
